quality.target_check: Full Q8 target suite passes complete logits/features, mixed FP16/FP32 KV, verification widths 2–8, C1/2/4/6/8, snapshots, 8K+1025 continuation and capacity 262144.
quality.greedy_agreement: All 128 tokens match within Gufo AR/DFlash2 at both depths. All four modes match at d0. At d32K the reference differs from its own AR and from Gufo; this does not establish original-checkpoint parity.

rejected.smaller_q8_verification_staging: Byte-exact, slower on both complete FFN shapes.

causal_prefill_and_forks.kernel_scheduling: Packed V is loaded after PV. Row-first accumulation reuses normalization scales; scalar visible-tail FMAs retain each output reduction order. Large shallow chunks also use packed heads in existing FFN scratch, recovering the shallow prefill rate. The final scheduling variants are byte-exact to the qualified causal-tail implementation.

c8.policy: Q8 all-adaptive greedy C8 chooses one width from private acceptance histories and measured complete-cycle costs. All eight fully accepted short blocks permit a full-width probe. C1/C2/C6, fixed, sampled and mixed cohorts retain their prior decisions.

profile.scope: Four middle saturated selector-to-selector cycles per width; includes target verification, host acceptance, context injection and the next draft. Instrumented costs are used only to select shapes, not as headline speeds.

quality.scope: Real-weight C2/C4/C6/C8 draft layers, logits, actual selector probabilities, private sampled RNG, fixed/adaptive policy, pending injection and persistent state. c8.timing_control: Sequential isolated Nix release servers; KDE crash-reporting user socket paused for matched controls and restored afterward. No concurrent GPU workload or build.
c8.scope: Focused hard pair, repetition and generated-history d32K forks; this is not a refreshed nine-case concurrency matrix. Deep requests append 2,060 tokens each and interleave prefill with decoding.

c2_c6.policy: Q8 all-adaptive greedy C2/C6 choose one width using summed private acceptance histories and complete measured cycle costs. Full short blocks probe wider together. C1, fixed, sampled and mixed cohorts retain their previous decisions.
c2_c6.profile_scope: Four middle complete selector-to-selector cycles per fixed width, after a warm repetitive cohort; includes verification, host acceptance, context injection and next draft. Used to choose shapes, not as headline speeds.
c2_c6.control_scope: One warmed shallow hard-pair/repetition cohort and one matched d32K generated-history continuation per binary/concurrency. Deep requests reuse 32,764 tokens and append 2,060 tokens; new prefill interleaves with decoding. All rates are sums of individual request decode rates.
c2_c6.timing_control: Sequential isolated release servers, no GPU peer or build; the KDE crash-reporting launch socket was paused for the controls and restored afterward.
c2_c6.quality: Every measured completion matches isolated AR. Real-weight C2/C4/C6/C8 layers, logits, selector probabilities, private sampled RNG, fixed/adaptive history, pending injection and persistent state pass. C1 retains the same 128 output tokens and 292/78 draft/accepted counts, with PP in the preceding paired range and TG 16.13 tok/s.

ragged_verification.method: Fresh HTTP servers, requested tg128, one warmup and one measured repetition, no prompt-cache hits in shallow controls. Reported throughput is the sum of individual request decode rates, averaged across cohorts. Deep control restores the same generated frontier. C6 baseline repeated only after a slower control exposed scheduling-dependent over-proposal.

profile.scope: Selector-to-selector cycles in the second half of dispatches; excludes inter-request spans above 1.5s. Profile timings, not benchmark rates.

ragged_verification.c1_note: Measured on the ragged-kernel binary 8910e51f. The subsequent controller change only handles C3/C5/C7; C1 is unchanged.
interpretation: A probe supported by two strong fully accepted histories preserves repetition as neutral histories join an odd cohort.
The 12-row grouping alone is inconclusive end-to-end; generalized ragged groups improve C8.
Odd cohorts must retain shared width selection; falling back to C1 costs changes proposal work as admissions/completions change cohort size.

Kernel rows retain scalar FP32 bits; target logits, all feature taps and rollback match, with guarded output bounds. Draft probabilities, private sampled RNG and persistent state pass at every width C2 through C8.
Cross-engine output agreement is not an accuracy measurement; original checkpoint parity remains unproven.
